rule: Exactly one sanctioned scratch directory: .tmp directly under the working directory. A plain relative path may start with .tmp (or ./.tmp); no other dot segment anywhere, no .., no symlink on the way, inside the workspace. Removal keeps every other #4105 condition: the session made it with a mkdir-only run_command, git tracks nothing under it, it holds only the session's own files and directories. rmdir is accepted only for .tmp and directories inside it.
